paite: Ephraimte azukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu tung leh akilawmna uh thupi pak vul lel laitak, uain thazoh a omte phaizang hausatak lutang tung a omte atung uh agik hi!
heading: Mallam Israel Gam Vauhilhna
english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N mihat thilhihtheitak anei a; ama'n, gial thupitak ke phuakphuak, huihpi thilhihse lemlum bang leh tui lian thupi let zuazua bang mai in, lei ah apai ek ding.
english: Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

paite: Ephraimte zukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu lah sikden in a-om ding a;
english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

paite: akilawmna uh thupi pak vul laitak, phaizang hausatak lutang tung a om, nipi ma a theipi min masapen, a-enmi in amuh a, akhut a a-omtak a anek khit sek bang ahi ding hi.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh, thupina lallukhu leh kilawmna lukhute, amikhosuaksunte a ding in ahi ding;
english: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;

paite: Vaihawm dia tu a ding in vaihawmna khate, kulh kongkhak bul a hon sualte nangkik mite a ding in hatna ahi ding.
english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

paite: Himahleh huaite leng uain ziak in akipekpek ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; siampute leh zawlneite leng zu ziak in akipekpek ua, uain valh khit in a-om ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; kilakna thute ah akipekpek ua, vaihawmna thu ah ahoihoi uhi.
heading: Isai Leh Judah Zawlnei Zukhamte
english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

paite: Mun siang mahmah om lou khop in dohkan tengteng lah luak leh thilnin in adim hi.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

paite: Ama'n theihna lam a kua ahia asinsak ding? Thukhah leng ama'n kua ahia atheihsak sin laitei? Nawinek tawptungte leh nawi neksak nawnlouhte ahi ding uam?
english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

paite: Thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna, thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna chiantouh; dan tung a dan, dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik, huai ah tawmchik chih ngenta ahih ziak in.
english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

paite: Ahi, muk lamdang pumi zang in, pau tuam in hiai mite kiang ah thu agen zawta ding.
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language;

paite: Hiai lah khawlna ahi a, atawlte khawlsak un; hiai lah kihihhalhna ahi, achihte; himahleh amau angaikhe nuam kei ua.
english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary”; and “This is the refreshing”; yet they would not hear.

paite: Huaiziak in apai ua, athal a apuk ua, akitapgawp ua, thang a a-awk ua, mat a a-omtheihna ding un, TOUPA thu amaute a ding in, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, dan tung a dan chiantouh; dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik huai ah tawmchik chih ngen a ahi mai ding hi.
english: Therefore the word of Yahweh will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

paite: Huaiziak in mi muhsithatte aw, hiai mite, Jerusalem a omte, vai hawmsakte aw, TOUPA thu za un.
heading: Zion A Suangphum
english: Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

paite: Sihna toh thu i khungta, Sheol ah thu i kichiamta; vuakna tui lian a luansuak hun chiang in lei pha in zaw aluang kei ding; zuauthute i kihumbitna ding in i zang ua, zuau nuai ah lah i buta ngal ua, na chih ziak un.
english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. are we in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ding, "Ngai in, suang, suang ettelsa, akil a suang manphatak phumkip mahmah, Zion ah suangphum ding in ka lem hi; agingtami zaw akin kei ding.
english: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

paite: "Vaihawmna diktat a tansakna khau ding in ka zang ding a, diktatna lah a-ulum khai ding in ka zang ding a, gial in kihumbitna zuauthute aphiatmang vek ding a, tuite'n lah bukna atum ding.
english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

paite: Huan sihna toh na thukhun uh akiphel ding a, Sheol toh na chiam uh leng apiching kei ding, vuakna tui lian aluansuak hun chiang in. Huai hun chiang in sikden in na om ding uhi.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

paite: Aluansuak peuhmah chiang in nou ahon la zel dia; zingsang teng, sun leh zan in, aluangsuak ding a; thukhah omdan theihsiam lah thil mulkimhuai ngen ahi ding," chi in.
english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

paite: Lupna lah khekhuanna ding in atom lo zen a, puanthuah lah lukhuhna ding in aneu lua hi.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

paite: Anasep, anasep lamdang aseptheihna ding leh athilhih, athilhih lamdang azuihtheihna ding in, TOUPA Perazim tang a athou bang in athou sin ngal a, Gibeon Phaizang a aheh bang in aheh sin hi.
english: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

paite: Huchi in mi muhsit chingte hi nawn kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kolbutte uh muanhuaitak in abawl kha ding uh; tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a seh, leitung pumpi tung a atunsak ding. Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan in ka za hi.
english: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.

paite: Bildoh unla, ka aw za un; ngaikhia unla, ka thugen za un.
heading: Pathian Pilna
english: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

paite: Leilet mi in chi thehna ding in lei tatlak lou in alet ngei ahia? Aleikhalte tatlak lou in akhenkham in ahihzan ngei a hia?
english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

paite: Atung a tohtam khit in mohurite athehdalh kei a hia? Zirate leng atheh kei a hia? Buhte avual in, huit buhte leng amun sehsa ah, vaibuhte leng anawlzul ah atuh sek kei a hia?
english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

paite: A Pathian in lah amah diktak in athuzoh in asinsak ngal a.
english: For his God instructs him in right judgment, and teaches him.

paite: Mohuri lah buhchilna khawl in achil ngei ngal kei ua, zira tung ah leng kangtalai khe atuksak ngei kei uh; mohuri zaw chiang in akhen ua, zira leng khetbuk in akhen zaw sek uhi.
english: For the dill are not threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

paite: Tanghou bawlna buh gawizan in a-om a, ama'n tangtawn in avo kei ding a, akangtalai khe leh asakolte'n dalhsak mahleh, agawizansak ngei kei hi.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

paite: Huaite leng sepaihte' TOUPA, lemtheihna a mi lamdang mahmah leh pilna a mihoih mahmah a kipan a pawt ahi.
english: This also comes forth from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
